calibration_label_composition.test_name: Sensitivity to Unlabelled Calibration Class Composition
calibration_label_composition.insight: Even when calibrated with 100% normal or 100% defect data, CORAL yields >48% balanced accuracy because the dominant shift is rig-level sensor scale and high-frequency resonance, which is shared across operating states. Balanced calibration provides the highest accuracy (53.8%).
